prompt: In a sterile industrial facility, a silver robotic arm on the left extends a metallic gear toward a central conveyor belt where a partially assembled chassis rests. A technician in a blue jumpsuit stands center-left, holding a tablet and pointing at the robot's joint while looking intently at the screen. To the right, another worker in an orange vest leans over a control panel, pressing buttons with focused determination. In the foreground, a red toolbox sits open on the floor, revealing wrenches and screwdrivers arranged neatly inside. A yellow safety barrier runs along the bottom edge, separating the viewer from the active zone. Behind the central chassis, a third robot arm holds a welding torch, poised but inactive. A stack of gray metal sheets leans against the back wall on the far right. Overhead, bright fluorescent lights cast sharp shadows on the polished concrete floor, highlighting dust motes in the air. The background features rows of identical machinery fading into perspective under cool white lighting. The image captures the precise moment of human-machine collaboration with high-definition clarity and realistic textures. This is a photorealistic photo.
